contract: Append-only factual public milestones. Entries describe capabilities already delivered on the stated date; they are not incident records and do not imply semantic-version compatibility.

releases.title: Canonical public origin
facts: The canonical public site origin became https://worldhotlines.org.
The Railway hostname remains a deployment fallback rather than the published canonical origin.

releases.title: Widget v1
facts: A public client-side widget v1 was added.
The widget uses the static API and shared resolver without sending finder selections to a hosted query endpoint.

releases.title: Static API v1
facts: A public keyless static API v1 was added with country artifacts, a record index, a manifest, and a local resolver module.

releases.title: Stable hotline record IDs
facts: Opaque weh_ record IDs were added to the canonical dataset and guarded against unintended changes.
